TRAVELLER_ASTROGATION.Settings.HomeSyste: World the Astrogation scene opens on. A blank value uses Regina. When several worlds share the name, the Spinward Marches world is used.
TRAVELLER_ASTROGATION.Settings.JumpRatin: Parsecs the ship can jump. Used for routes and the worlds listed within range.
TRAVELLER_ASTROGATION.Settings.ZoomMin.H: Smallest explore-map magnification. 1 is one chart pixel per screen pixel.
TRAVELLER_ASTROGATION.Settings.ZoomMax.H: Largest explore-map magnification. When this is below the minimum, the two values are swapped.
TRAVELLER_ASTROGATION.Settings.DarkMap.H: Draw the chart on black with white ink. Leave this off for the light chart.
TRAVELLER_ASTROGATION.Settings.SelectedH: Draw the selected world's hex border in yellow.
TRAVELLER_ASTROGATION.Settings.Compendiu: Use sectors saved in the Sector Data compendium when they are present. Sectors that are not packed still come from Traveller Map.
Do not call Traveller Map. The map, find, and routes stay inside the sectors saved in Sector Data.
TRAVELLER_ASTROGATION.Settings.ImportSec: Save every sector in a grid box to the Sector Data compendium, including borders and trade routes. A sector already stored is kept, and the World Index is rebuilt.
